widget.name: Website chat
widget.description: The whole conversation with the visitor right inside the lead card: the manager sees the thread, replies in one field and can ask for a tax ID or a phone number — the input opens in the visitor's chat. Works both for website chat leads and for Telegram channel leads.
widget.short_description: Chat with the visitor and ask for a tax ID or phone from the lead card

status.sent_phone: Phone field opened for the visitor
